raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: Despite correctly gathering the directors’ birthdates (Eric Mendelsohn: 1964-11-01; Harry A. Pollard: 1879-01-23), the Planner misapplied the comparison logic and concluded the wrong film had the older director. They improperly compared Eric Mendelsohn’s current age to Pollard’s age at death and reversed the chronological order, stating Judy Berlin’s director is older, when in fact Tonight at Twelve’s director (Pollard, born 1879) is older.
